terminal_verdict.recommended_current_action: Use the release for research and external bridge studies; do not deploy for patient care or submit a clinical/Nature-level claim yet.

evidence_index.self_reference_note: Release-level receipts are bound by a separate terminal manifest and are not embedded in the archive whose hash they describe.

supported_claims.claim: NOSTOS 0.3.0 is a deterministic, data-free, locally executable structural-measurement software release candidate.
supported_claims.scope: 738 files plus release manifest; fresh frozen install; 292 clean-room tests passed and 8 dependency/data-dependent tests skipped; byte-identical second build

supported_claims.claim: The supported local and T7 runtimes execute the full applicable repository test matrices and finite 2048 by 2048 FFT smoke tests.
supported_claims.scope: Python 3.13; 297 local tests with 4 skips and 308 T7 tests with no skips; RTX 5070 Ti CUDA execution verified

supported_claims.claim: A frozen scale-conditioned validity contract reduced silent-invalid tensor-coherence risk relative to conventional acquisition QC on untouched BioSR F-actin fields.
supported_claims.scope: 8 reference fields, 980 primary eligible rows, 95.0% coverage, risk 0.0387 versus 0.0735, 47.4% relative reduction; controlled degradations on one public SIM resource

supported_claims.claim: A declared local structure-tensor endpoint reproduces the deposited PSHG orientation reference within the frozen public acquisition profile.
supported_claims.scope: 48 breast ROIs and 1,367,747 eligible pixels in the scientific confirmation; median axial error 7.59 degrees after a transform frozen on a separate skin subset

supported_claims.claim: The unstained PSHG production path exports complete, hash-registered measurement artifacts and withholds unsupported clinical conclusions.
supported_claims.scope: 4 additional hash-selected fields in v1.4; pooled median reference error 7.53 degrees; p95 end-to-end compute/export 0.452 seconds; acquisition time excluded

supported_claims.claim: A format-compatible but provenance-unverified acquisition remains measurable for research while being explicitly demoted and clinically withheld.
supported_claims.scope: author-operated deterministic local HTTP audit; four decoded visual products; not a human-factors or browser-matrix study

supported_claims.claim: Reference-mask vascular-network and trabecular-thickness endpoints retain bounded cross-data or cross-software evidence.
supported_claims.scope: STARE reference masks and eight public trabecular-bone volumes; these are endpoint-specific measurements, not universal biological or diagnostic validation

rejected_or_unsupported_claims: one universal score or representation that identifies every specimen across tissues
universal superiority over focused estimators, radiomics, scattering or established domain tools
validated automatic cartilage segmentation or a continuous osteochondral-interface claim
transfer of the PSHG profile to a new microscope, operator, tissue or surgical environment
intraoperative acquisition speed; current timing starts after image files exist
diagnosis, disease severity, tissue viability, margin status, mechanics or treatment guidance
clinical utility, safety, decision impact, patient outcome or regulatory clearance
Nature Methods or Nature Biomedical Engineering readiness on current public-data evidence
a double-digit-impact-factor submission that is presently defensible without new external acquisition evidence

readiness_gates.evidence: Definitive v29 archive, two retained failure receipts, verified clean-room execution and byte-identical rebuild.
PSHG orientation and production artifacts pass on the deposited acquisition family only.

readiness_gates.gate: G2 independent instrument and operator bridge
readiness_gates.evidence: No independently operated second instrument or acquisition family has passed a frozen bridge protocol.
No co-registered fresh surgical tissue study links NOSTOS output to an adjudicated structural, histologic or mechanical reference.

readiness_gates.gate: G4 intraoperative workflow and human factors
readiness_gates.evidence: Ten-frame acquisition, motion, focusing, field selection, sterility, operator time, failure recovery and usability are unmeasured.

readiness_gates.gate: G5 prospective clinical endpoint and decision impact
readiness_gates.evidence: No locked clinical endpoint, prospective cohort, comparison to standard care or patient-level decision study exists.
BioSR v9 supports one selective-validity result, but several cross-domain support and universal-representation gates failed and remain retained.

sample_plan.verdict: Do not add millions of tiles. Add a small number of independent, information-rich specimens in staged gates.

stages.minimum_design: 3 to 5 independent specimens spanning low, medium and high signal; 2 operators; 3 repositioning repeats; no clinical-performance claim
stages.purpose: Find coordinate, focus, motion, support-map and timing failures cheaply before freezing thresholds.

stages.minimum_design: approximately 12 to 20 independent specimens or donors, with specimen-level inference and an adjudicated co-registered reference
stages.purpose: Estimate coverage, silent-invalid risk, agreement and failure modes with uncertainty; exact size must be justified by the endpoint precision target.

stages.minimum_design: sample size derived from the locked clinical endpoint, expected prevalence/effect and confidence-width target; independent operators and temporal separation required
stages.purpose: Support a clinical or high-impact translational claim without patch-level pseudoreplication.

sample_plan.unit_rule: Pixels, tiles, perturbations and repeat frames are technical observations. The specimen, donor or patient remains the inferential unit unless the study design proves otherwise.

blocking_requirements.blocker: The PSHG claim is tied to one public instrument family and author-operated analysis.
blocking_requirements.closure: Freeze a bridge protocol, then pass it on a second instrument with independent operators, specimen-level clustering and an acquisition-appropriate reference.

blocking_requirements.blocker: The verified unstained profile is breast PSHG, not the intended intraoperative osteochondral or bone use case.
blocking_requirements.closure: Acquire fresh target tissue with co-registered histology, polarimetry/SHG reference and, if claimed, mechanical testing. Lock one clinically meaningful endpoint before analysis.

blocking_requirements.blocker: Only compute and export latency are measured; the ten-frame acquisition and operator pathway are not timed or stress tested.
blocking_requirements.closure: Measure specimen-to-result latency, motion failures, refocus/reposition repeats, abstention rate and operator errors in a simulated-use study before any operating-room claim.

blocking_requirements.blocker: There is no prospective clinical reference, safety, decision-impact or outcome evidence.
blocking_requirements.closure: After technical bridging, register and run a prospective patient-level study with locked intended use, adjudicated reference, uncertainty, subgroup analysis and failure accounting.

blocking_requirements.blocker: Most component estimators are established; one BioSR validity-contract success is not yet a general platform-level advantage.
blocking_requirements.closure: Prospectively demonstrate lower silent-invalid risk at matched useful coverage on at least one second modality and show that response-geometry or abstention information changes a scientifically important conclusion beyond individual methods and ordinary QC.

blocking_requirements.blocker: No unaided external user has executed the frozen release and returned an unedited receipt.
blocking_requirements.closure: Obtain an identified external execution from the release archive and archive the public tag with a DOI.

blocking_requirements.blocker: Institutional determination, privacy/security review, authorship declarations and regulatory intended-use analysis are incomplete.
blocking_requirements.closure: Complete institutional, clinical engineering, cybersecurity and regulatory review before patient-data or operating-room deployment.

novelty_assessment.strongest_novel_object: A calibrated response-and-validity contract that preserves physical scale, perturbation behavior, evidence maturity and explicit abstention around structural measurements.
novelty_assessment.not_novel_by_itself: FFT, structure tensors, Hessian filters, thickness, topology, variograms and local HTTP visualization are established components.
novelty_assessment.current_decisive_result: The v9 BioSR selective contract reduced silent-invalid tensor-coherence risk at 95% coverage on an untouched controlled-degradation confirmation.
novelty_assessment.remaining_review_threat: The advantage has not yet been shown prospectively on an independent acquisition modality tied to an important biological or clinical endpoint.

decision_rule: Technical use on the exact locked public acquisition may be described precisely. Do not call NOSTOS clinically usable, intraoperatively validated, or Nature-ready until G2 through G5 are closed with new immutable, independently generated evidence.
